title: Prompt typed big, then bloomed into a step list
summary: A wordmark on a green gradient erases into big typing with a colour trail, cuts to the same line in a small prompt bar, then the bar blooms into a card whose tagged steps write themselves in under a second.
use_when: An agent or automation product that turns one instruction into a plan of steps
A short silent intro (about 5 s) for a feed or a landing hero loop
Showing input and structured output as one continuous object, no cut to a new scene
A light, calm brand where colour-coded tags can carry meaning

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking; wordmark ~3 % H, hero typing ~9 % H, UI text ~1.5 % H, list body ~1.2 % H

structure.shot: small wordmark lockup (mark + name + light second word) centred on a dark-to-light green blurred gradient; the name erases letter by letter from the left
structure.camera: static f0-25 (gradient drifts slowly), then push-in 1.00 -> ~3.0 f25-40 accelerating, easings.inExpo (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: hold 25 fr; letters removed from the left edge ~1 per fr f25-43; gradient washes to off-white over f35-45 (10 fr)

structure.shot: hero-size typing on off-white: one instruction sentence, about 6 words, centred, accent caret
structure.camera: static (text grows left to right; no scale change between cells 1.50 and 2.00)
structure.motion: typing ~23 chars/s (17 chars f45-67), 1 char/fr with 2 fr holds at word gaps; colour trail: newest 3-4 chars in the accent, cool to near-black over 4-5 fr per char; solid 2 px accent caret, no blink

structure.shot: wide shot: the same sentence continues inside a small white pill prompt bar with a round dark send button, on off-white
structure.motion: f68 one black frame, bar already placed; typing resumes at UI size, same trail, ends f93; caret removed; f100 send button colour swap dark -> accent in 1 fr, no press visible; accent glow ramps inside the bar f99-102 (3 fr)

structure.shot: bar dissolves into a blurred accent ellipse that grows into a white card; numbered steps with colour-coded tag pills write themselves in, nested sub-steps, an add-step row
structure.camera: static; card content scrolls up ~8 px at 720p from f119 to keep the newest row near centre
structure.motion: bar blur 0 -> ~20 px f101-103, card rect grows ~1.4x by f105 (springs.layout, overshoot not measurable); rows from f106 every 3-4 fr (9 rows by f129); per row ~6-8 fr: number 1 fr -> tag pill scaleX from left 2-3 fr -> text reveal with soft accent-tinted leading edge ~5 fr; card height grows with springs.layout

structure.shot: rows clear and the card collapses back into the blurred accent ellipse on off-white (end state, not the opening frame)
structure.camera: static (pan 0,-38 px/s @1920 in motion.json is the card collapsing, not camera)
structure.motion: reverse of the morph: text fades, card shrinks into a wide blurred ellipse, easings.inExpo ~12 fr (±0.25 s); ellipse holds to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (off-white), fg, accent (trail, caret, send, glow), display font; wordmark from brand.logo
params.content.wordmark: product name lockup shown 0-1.33 s, erased letter by letter
params.content.prompt: one instruction sentence, 30-45 chars, typed big then finished in the bar
params.content.splitAt: character index where the hero typing cuts to the bar (default ~17 chars)
params.content.steps: 6-10 steps {n, tag, tagColor, text, depth}; tags 1 word, text 4-10 words
params.timing.rowGap: frames between list rows (default 3-4 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; bar and card width cap at 60 % of frame width
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured by a human on 30 fps frames, confirmed against 4 fps sheets: typing ~23 chars/s, colour trail 3-4 chars over 4-5 fr each; one black frame at f68 on the big-type -> bar cut; send = 1 fr colour swap, glow ramps 3 fr; bar -> glow -> card morph ~6 fr total; list rows every 3-4 fr, each row writes in 6-8 fr (number, tag pill, text with tinted leading edge). Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (not used as an id): letter-erase for the wordmark removed letter by letter from the left during the push. Missing components: MeshGradient backdrop, bar-to-card glow morph, tagged step rows with nesting.
